items.name: tasks-page
items.title: NocoBase AI Employee Tasks Page Example
items.description: Application-owned page that runs AI employee tasks on support tickets through the application's global AI entry.
items.docs: Requires @nocobase/app-plugin-ai-employee and @nocobase/app-plugin-ai-employee-example, the AI Employee plugin's nocobase-ai item installed in client/extensions/nocobase-ai, and a global AI entry (NocoBaseAIRootProvider and an AIChatProvider bound to the global controller) around the signed-in layout. The installed page is application-owned, and its extension overrides only the plugin's route component. Review upgrades with a three-way merge.
